attempts.text:
The lowest-cost plan I found totals 401: 241 minutes of driving plus 160 in deferral penalties. It rescues 12 people and defers 8 adults.

**Constraints from the report**
- **Closed roads:** I treated Benighat–Syaphru and Panchakanya–Benighat as unusable because of the fast floodwater.
- **Evacuation points:** People can only be dropped at Dupcheshwar shelter and Panchakanya hospital. Tadi school is not designated, so it can't be used as a drop-off.

**Decisions**

| Location | People | Decision | Cost | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tadi school and Benighat market | 1 child, 3 elderly | car1 takes all four in one loop | 27 driving | Both groups fit in one trip, which is cheaper than two separate trips (32) |
| Tarkeshwar care home | 3 elderly, 1 adult | car1 makes a round trip from Dupcheshwar | 84 driving | Deferring them would cost 170 |
| Trishuli market | 4 elderly | car2 makes a round trip from Panchakanya | 130 driving | Deferring them would cost 200 |
| Trishuli market | 4 adults | Defer | 80 penalty | A second round trip would cost 130 |
| Uttargaya care home | 4 adults | Defer | 80 penalty | A round trip from Dupcheshwar would cost 98 |

Going through Uttargaya on the Tarkeshwar trip doesn't help, because it adds 21 minutes and car1 is already full with the four people from Tarkeshwar.

**Cost**
- **car1 driving:** 27 + 84 = 111
- **car2 driving:** 130
- **Deferral penalties:** 80 + 80 = 160
- **Total:** 111 + 130 + 160 = 401

<plan>
drive car1 dupcheshwar-shelter tadi-school
load car1 child 1
drive car1 tadi-school benighat-market
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 benighat-market dupcheshwar-shelter
unload car1 child 1
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 dupcheshwar-shelter benighat-market
drive car1 benighat-market myagang-care-home
drive car1 myagang-care-home tarkeshwar-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-care-home myagang-care-home
drive car1 myagang-care-home benighat-market
drive car1 benighat-market dupcheshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car2 panchakanya-hospital trishuli-market
load car2 elderly 4
drive car2 trishuli-market panchakanya-hospital
unload car2 elderly 4
defer trishuli-market adult 4
defer uttargaya-care-home adult 4
</plan>
